launchGates.details: GitHub default branch was observed as feature/artemisix19-autonomous-generator while local launch work is on main.
Transcript shows SSH push failed with Permission denied (publickey). Use SSH key setup or HTTPS with gh auth setup-git.
Run vercel deploy --yes, smoke-test preview routes, then promote/deploy production.
.env.local, .vercel, node_modules, .next, PEM/private keys, and raw protected HTML must not be tracked.

publicLaunchSequence: Confirm GitHub default branch and Vercel production branch.
Push reviewed launch commits to the canonical repository.
Smoke-test homepage, sitemap, Labs, ArtemisIX19, Library, Programs, Insights, Academy, Tools, and audience routes.
Run desktop and mobile browser checks, console check, and horizontal overflow check.
Promote a validated preview or run vercel deploy --prod --yes.
Attach production/custom domain after production QA passes.

publishingSystem.goal: Generate public-safe Artemis articles, infographics, and social post packages for website publication and later social distribution.
publishingSystem.firstImplementation: Static or client-safe generation with structured TypeScript data and MDX output. No database, auth, payments, external API keys, or social tokens in the first release.
platformApiPhase: Meta Graph API for Facebook Pages

safetyRules: Do not publish raw protected HTML.
Do not publish private client/project data.
Do not publish private coordinates, source paths, Vercel tokens, OAuth tokens, API keys, PEM/private keys, or .env.local content.
Do not imply external AI execution, server-side agents, or social auto-posting until those systems exist.
Date-check and source-check current software, AI, shipping, archaeology, and market-comparison claims before publication.
